title: Downtown Private Guest Home w Sauna & Full Kitchen
description:
No Cleaning Fees!!

Take a break and unwind at this peaceful oasis. It is a maisonette the size of a one bedroom apartment. There are soaring ceilings with historic exposed beams. It has a full kitchen and sauna as well!

This house is conveniently located to all things Downtown Nashville has to offer, but makes you feel like you are at a retreat far away.

The bed is a brand new Stearns and Foster's Lowes Hotel mattress. The house comes equipped with wifi, kitchen essentials, and luxury linens.
